I agree with the Router's assessment of the hand as a minor quality defect rather than a structural collapse.
The 'perspective_distortion' (Severity 1.5) is subtle but valid; AI often struggles to keep text lines perfectly planar on curved surfaces. 
No new catastrophic artifacts were found by experts, but the text failure is severe enough to define the image quality.

A 'menu' is defined by its content (list of items); without legible text, it is merely a prop or hallucination of a menu. It is better than a complete mismatch (0.0) but far from a perfect, usable menu (5.0).
